findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Loading JSON from potentially untrusted sources
 * @description Finds json.loads or json.load calls so they can be reviewed for untrusted input usage.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/json-loads-review
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-020
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("json").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Review this JSON loading operation to ensure the input cannot be controlled by an attacker."
findings.hypothesis: Use of json.load/loads that may parse attacker-controlled data without validation.

message.text: Review this JSON loading operation to ensure the input cannot be controlled by an attacker.
